release.documentation: Final report is a post-release documentation update; release tag and source commit are not changed.

scope: Actual product forms and SQLite in an isolated synthetic fixture; final package verification covers published Program.Main smoke where feasible, MSI structure/admin extraction/file hashes, and six uploaded asset hashes.

initialManual.scope: Initial manual and Computer Use observations; not the current focus/sourcegen candidate

intermediateFocusBuild.scope: Focused list/settings checks and launcher preparation; no inferred native acceptance

currentCandidate.scope: Current candidate C01-C09 functional scenarios, including restart, real resume/capture, focus, note cancellation, drag/scroll, existing-folder insert/detach and delete/restore; full Desktop component suite

finalPublished.scope: Final clean-commit build, package and worker checks; actual product DLL restart/persistence/hotkey/exit repeated in the fixture. Not a repeat of every C01-C09 case and not normal Program.Main UI startup.

completed.claim: Unmodified B-to-A drag created a folder; A and B share its ParentId and collapsed children are hidden.
Folder expansion/collapse and temporary C avoidance/restoration confirmed by user and state transitions; saved layout unchanged.
User confirmed Korean input and automatic save; exact note persisted on A and editor closed.
Real visibility hotkey hid then showed eligible stickers without changing relationships or notes.

completed.input: candidate restart and read-only SQLite observation
completed.claim: Restart retained A/B folder membership, A Korean note, and C root membership; current observation includes the folder record.
C resume button opened the synthetic file in Notepad and persisted OpenRequested.
completed.limitation: OpenRequested is not a claim of verified document position restoration.

completed.claim: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F15 captured active Notepad content; Captured and CaptureCommitted plus exact synthetic NotepadSnapshot persisted in SQLite.
User confirmed search remains when clicking the same-app control window; transitions retain the 실사용 search and matching A/ancestor results.
User cancelled A's edited memo with Esc; observed draft was discarded and the original exact saved note remains.
completed.toolInterruption: Physical Esc intentionally interrupted a Computer Use call; the next list_windows call recovered. Not classified as a product failure.

completed.claim: User confirmed long-list drag/edge-scroll behavior; observations show topIndex 0 to 25 downward and 25 to 0 upward. Items 30 and 01 were committed under the same new folder.
completed.limitation: Confirms actual bidirectional scrolling and grouping, not native measurement of exact 300/120 ms timer intervals. Existing-folder insert/detach is recorded separately as C09.

completed.claim: Sky activation of Edge succeeded; recent list visibility changed from true before the external-app transition to false afterward.
completed.limitation: Snapshot timestamps do not measure hide latency. A subsequent browser state query was blocked by URL policy; activation and product list visibility were independently observed.

completed.claim: User confirmed item 30 deletion and restoration. Seven snapshots include its deleted state; final restore retains original folder parent and note, with DeletedAtUtc null.
User confirmed item 29 insertion into the existing folder and detachment to the root. Intermediate parent equals that folder; final ParentId is null and note is preserved.
Final product DLL retained Korean note and folder membership after restart; real visibility hotkey changed visible product stickers 5 to 0 to 5, then exited with no product windows.

Final MSI structure, administrative extraction and every extracted-file hash passed; portable DLL and clean source archive match; six uploaded assets match server digests and release is public/stable.

unconfirmedAttempts.claim: Attempted C-to-existing-folder drag produced no observed relation or location change.
unconfirmedAttempts.classification: Not a completed drag acceptance and not a confirmed product defect

automatedRegression.suite: Final clean-commit Release build and test suites
Final MSI structure and administrative extraction

workerTiming.scope: Synthetic UnsupportedTarget requests to isolated production builds; not real target capture

finalPublishedWorker.scope: Real published Program.Main worker entry point with synthetic UnsupportedTarget requests; no actual target capture or normal application UI launch

historicalAnomalies.issue: 713 assertions passed followed by WinForms SynchronizationContext continuation exception during fixture teardown
historicalAnomalies.resolution: BrowserCommitChecks now excludes unrelated asynchronous startup migration/sticker loading using List/current-version settings; subsequent full run ended cleanly.
historicalAnomalies.limitation: Does not establish real application close-during-startup safety

historicalAnomalies.issue: Initial CreateGraphics exception in SV15 path
historicalAnomalies.resolution: Not reproduced in subsequent full runs; SV15 passed. No speculative product catch added.

scopeLimitations.note: Planned where feasible; real worker entry point 6/6 and actual published DLL Form checks do not imply normal UI entry-point execution.
